newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-SUCCESSFUL TEST FOR STEWART'S NEW CAR.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-SUCCESSFUL TEST FOR STEWART'S NEW CAR.

text.p: Ex-world champion Jackie Stewart said on Tuesday he was more than satisfied with the result of the debut test of his new Formula One motor racing car at Silverstone.

The Ford-powered SF-1, driven by Brazilian Rubens Barrichello and Dane Jan Magnussen, completed 24 laps of the damp circuit without any problems and will now be flown for a major four day test at Jerez in Spain. The session starts on Sunday.
"This test was very satisfactory considering the conditions," said Stewart, whose car had only previously run in a straight line at Ford's Boreham testing facility.
"I have a very good feeling from this test," said Barrichello, who drove for Jordan last year. "Considering it is its first time on the race track, the car gave us a great deal to be positive about."
Stewart Grand Prix's managing director Paul Stewart added: "It has been an excellent step in our preparations for the first race in Melbourne in March."
Stewart unveiled their car last month less than a year after the team's inception in Detroit in January 1996. It is thought to be first designed and created completely by computer.
